cohort: 317 women with CHTN and 106 women with CHTN-DM who intended exclusive or partial breastfeeding
finding: Despite similar intentions to breastfeed, women with CHTN had higher rates of breastfeeding initiation compared to women with CHTN-DM.
mod_finding: While intention to breastfeed was similar, breastfeeding initiation rates were higher for women with chronic hypertension compared to those with chronic hypertension superimposed on pregestational diabetes.
